title: ProductDetectedPriceChange - Data API
description: Represents a detected change in price for a product associated with a partner account. This object is available in API version 63.0 and later.

AccountId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AccountId.description: References the partner account for which the price change was detected. This field is a relationship field.

EffectiveDate.description: Date when the new price becomes effective for the product.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the record was last referenced by the current user. Useful for activity tracking.

LastViewedDate.description: Date and the timestamp the record was last referenced by a user or system process.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: Unique name or identifier for the price change record.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: User or group that owns this record. This is a polymorphic relationship field. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

ProcessingStatus.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ProcessingStatus.description: Indicates the current processing stage of the price change. Possible values are: Completed Inactive New Processing—In Progress

ProductId.description: References the product for which the price change was detected. This field is a relationship field.
